statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. The initial post-CPI response remains two-sided and away from a session extreme, so persistent no-retracement structure is not verified.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH; Tail remains below the block threshold. The cash open and preliminary Michigan sentiment are the principal remaining conditional path checkpoints.
headline: Post-CPI futures hold gains without a verified one-way path; Tail remains WATCH
body: August CPI rose 0.4% month over month and 3.4% year over year. Nasdaq-100 E-minis remained positive after the release, while delayed NQ was inside the session range rather than pinned to an extreme. Elevated Treasury yields, oil above $100, and geopolitical risk keep Stress extreme.
